sections.label: MinLaw Rule of Law priorities
sections.summary: MinLaw will uphold the Rule of Law, improve access to justice, strengthen Singapore's legal and IP hub status, and better use state assets.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Law (MinLaw) will continue to uphold the Rule of Law and public trust in Singapore’s legal system.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We will improve access to justice, strengthen Singapore’s position as a global legal and intellectual property (IP) hub and make better use of state assets to support the country’s social and economic needs.

sections.label: Online harm and legal processes
sections.summary: MinLaw will study a new agency for online harm victims and simplify laws, court procedures, digital Wills, judgment enforcement and asset tracing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: MinLaw will study the need for a new agency to better support victims of online harm with an appropriate framework for relief.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: MinLaw will continue to make laws, legal processes and court procedures easier for Singaporeans to understand and use.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We are reviewing digital Wills, improving how civil judgments are enforced and giving courts stronger powers to trace debtors’ assets.

sections.label: Simplified Insolvency Programme 2.0
sections.summary: The new Simplified Insolvency Programme 2.0 will offer faster help for struggling businesses while protecting creditors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The new Simplified Insolvency Programme 2.0 will offer faster help for struggling businesses while protecting creditors.

sections.label: Civil legal aid outreach
sections.summary: MinLaw will expand outreach and support for civil legal aid and criminal defence aid with lawyers, agencies, volunteers and the community.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: MinLaw will expand outreach and support for civil legal aid and criminal defence aid, working with lawyers, social service agencies, volunteers and the broader community.

sections.label: International partnerships and arbitration review
sections.summary: MinLaw will build thought leadership and international partnerships through events like Singapore Convention Week and review international arbitration laws.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: MinLaw will continue to build thought leadership and deepen international partnerships through events like the Singapore Convention Week.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We will also review our international arbitration laws to keep Singapore competitive for dispute resolution.

sections.label: Legaltech and IP Strategy 2030
sections.summary: The Legal Innovation and Future-Readiness Transformation Initiative will help law firms adopt legaltech and AI, and IP Strategy 2030 is being refreshed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Our Legal Innovation and Future-Readiness Transformation Initiative will help law firms adopt legaltech solutions and embrace the use of AI and technology to support their work.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We are refreshing our IP Strategy 2030 to attract more IP and intangible asset (IA) activity.

sections.label: Digital Conveyancing Portal development
sections.summary: SLA is developing a Digital Conveyancing Portal to digitalise property transactions for improved convenience, transparency and security for buyers, sellers, law firms, banks and real estate professionals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: SLA is also developing a Digital Conveyancing Portal to digitalise property transactions to improve convenience, transparency and security for buyers, sellers, law firms, banks and real estate professionals.
